notes.title: sdkwork-api-cloud-gateway-v0.1.13
notes.summary: Complete the v0.1.12 package matrix. Both windows-2022 jobs were cancelled at the shared workflow's 120-minute bound while cargo was still compiling the foundation graph, and the dependency checkout ignored failed git checkouts on MAX_PATH-length generated SDK trees; the framework package bound is now 240 minutes and every dependency checkout enables core.longpaths and fails on a non-zero git exit. The two container targets leave the GitHub release matrix: OCI release evidence requires a pushed repository@sha256 digest, this repository has no registry credentials, and SUPPLY_CHAIN_SECURITY_SPEC forbids substituting a local image id, so container images remain on the bin/docker-image.sh channel while this release ships the six Windows, Linux, and macOS server packages. The host installer also gains direct PostgreSQL host/port/name/user/password/SSL overrides next to the existing port, database-directory, and Redis options.
highlights: sdkwork-github-workflow (pinned ref 893a49f): the package job timeout moves from 120 to 240 minutes so a cold windows-2022 runner can finish the foundation graph, the dependency checkout enables core.longpaths and throws on a failed clone/fetch/checkout/submodule instead of building from a truncated tree, and the release uploader expands globstar globs in PowerShell so the aggregate `release-assets/**/*` set is not silently empty

sdkwork.workflow.json: the container-x64 standalone and cloud targets leave the GitHub matrix (registry credentials are absent and SUPPLY_CHAIN_SECURITY_SPEC forbids a local image id as container evidence); the bin/docker-image.sh channel still builds, pushes, and deploys those images

sdkwork.workflow.json + .github/workflows/package.yml: publish.aggregateRelease is enabled, so one aggregate job downloads all six package artifacts, renders the release notes once, and publishes a single release instead of racing six per-job uploads; the workflow also stops triggering on its own release.published event, so a tag run packages the matrix once

bin/packaging/install-ubuntu.sh: --database-host/-port/-name/-username/-password/-password-file/-ssl-mode generate /etc/sdkwork/database/database.env and a root:sdkwork 0640 secret referenced by SDKWORK_DATABASE_PASSWORD_FILE, so PostgreSQL is configurable at install time without hand-writing the profile
Cargo.lock regenerated against every dependency repository's main; scripts/build-windows-libopus.ps1 tolerates native stderr under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and decides success from the CMake exit code
version advanced to 0.1.13 across the app manifest, the workflow matrix artifact paths, package.json, and the dispatch default tag; the release notes cover only this version

notes.title: sdkwork-api-cloud-gateway-v0.1.12
notes.summary: Container image packaging now completes on a fresh registry. v0.1.11 shipped 6 of 8 package targets: both container targets failed in the Package step after a successful `docker build` because `docker image inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}'` aborts on an image that was built locally and never pushed — its RepoDigests slice is empty, and the Go template raises `slice index out of range` before the manifest is written. The identity probe now guards the index so the manifest falls back to the image Id and Size, and the OCI targets are declared in the app manifest alongside the server targets so release notes and package declarations agree.
highlights: build-api-cloud-gateway-container.mjs: the image identity probe tolerates an empty RepoDigests list (`{{if .RepoDigests}}`), so a locally built, unpushed image resolves from Id/Size instead of aborting the whole inspect

agent.app.config.json: artifacts.installConfig.packages declares all six server targets (windows/macos x standalone+cloud) plus the cloud container target, so release.notes packageIds resolve against real package declarations (check-app-manifest-standard was rejecting five unknown ids)
agent.app.config.json: windows/macos server packages declare their real targetPlatform/architecture, which previously mislabelled every non-Linux target as linux x64
sdkwork.workflow.json + package.json: version advanced to 0.1.12 across the workflow matrix artifact paths, the release default version, and the dispatch default tag
release notes for 0.1.12 cover only this version; earlier versions remain in the manifest history but are never re-published

notes.summary: CORS console-host pattern matching: the gateway expands SDKWORK_CORS_CONSOLE_HOST_{LABELS,SUFFIX,SCHEMES} against the registered base domains (SDKWORK_REGISTERED_SERVICE_BASE_DOMAINS) instead of carrying a hand-enumerated per-environment origin list, shrinking the deployed CORS allow-list from roughly 104 KiB to about 1 KiB while still matching exact single-label console hosts (no wildcard subdomain). Consumes sdkwork-web-core's RegisteredConsoleHosts policy hook and aligns every CORS carrier with the sdkwork-specs CORS standard (CORS_SPEC.md) via the check-cors-standard gate. Also fixes the co-located Snowflake node IDs (GATEWAY_IM_ID_NODE_ID 21/22/23/25/24) so the five same-host environments stop contending for the sdkwork_node_registry lease. Rebuilt and redeployed across all five WSL Ubuntu-22.04 environments.

Unify the operator surface on the bin/ nine-entrypoint family: image build, bundle packaging and deployment now route exclusively through bin/, and the install bundle source moved from scripts/docker/bundle to deployments/docker/bundle. Removes the legacy deploy toolkit (apply.sh/apply.ps1, wsl-redeploy-envs.sh, wsl-up-three-envs.sh, deploy-docker-environment.sh, deploy-cloud-environment.mjs, remote-deploy.sh, generate-nginx-conf.sh, install-certs.sh) because sdkwork-webserver owns the public reverse proxy edge. Re-syncs the Cargo.lock workspace dependency graph for the container feature. Restores LF line endings on 5 CRLF-polluted packaged migrations (sdkwork-appstore 0002/0003, sdkwork-generations 0001 up/down, sdkwork-webserver 0005) that would otherwise trip the migration checksum drift gate fail-closed at container startup; the repaired bytes match the checksums already recorded in ops_schema_migration_history across all five environments, so no database reconciliation was required.

Full rebuild and five-environment redeploy on WSL Ubuntu-22.04 Docker with host-native external PostgreSQL/Redis (Redis without password). Carries the sdkwork-cloudrouter 0041 forward migration (ai_mcp_* registry tables, iam_gateway_membership, ai_metering_usage indexes) that repairs an unversioned baseline drift which failed the postgres-runtime-schema readiness probe on pre-existing databases. Also regenerates Cargo.lock (hashlink).

Full rebuild and multi-environment redeploy verification on WSL Ubuntu-22.04 with external host PostgreSQL/Redis (Redis without password). Carries all 0.1.5 behavior (LF migration line endings, ai/models route dedup, zero-config consumer permissions).

Rebuild with LF line endings for all packaged database migrations (7 sibling repos were CRLF-polluted by an external editor/sync, tripping the migration checksum drift gate fail-closed at container startup). Carries the 0.1.4 ai/models route dedup fix and 0.1.3 zero-config consumer permissions.

Fix axum 'Overlapping method route' startup panic: GET /app/v3/api/ai/models is now served solely by the sdkwork-models catalog app router; agents no longer registers a duplicate snapshot-projection route. Also includes the 0.1.3 zero-config consumer permissions changes.

Zero-config consumer permissions: web-framework manifest gates no longer block app-api surfaces (tier 0-2); tenant-default organization context (org null/blank normalizes to 0) across knowledgebase/appstore/aiot/notary/github/shop/im; fixes systemic 40301/40304 on consumer journeys.
Deterministic release packaging: cloudrouter OpenAPI build scripts default to copy mode; rustfmt cleanups; multi-environment bundle and docker deployment hardening.
